scope: Ideal rigid stance and exact joint tracking, with linear geometry mapping. This is an analytical model, not native acceptance or a proof about all compliant dynamics.
uniform_model: Normalized stance speed a*sin(pi*s), s in [0,1].

proposal.speed_profile: Half-cosine acceleration over each endpoint ramp, constant speed between the ramps. Normalize to unit mean.

method_change: Retain the joint path but use a nonuniform phase clock. This changes the time law of paper Eqs. (1)-(3) and must be declared before dispatch.
